content:
{'translation': 'Knicks star Jalen Brunson hosted Saturday Night Live over the weekend and repeatedly failed to throw paper balls into a trash can — but it turns out a "fan" was behind the mishaps.'}

{'translation': 'SNL writer Dan Bulla revealed Sunday on his Instagram Story: "There was a hair dryer in the trash can, making it impossible for Jalen to make the shot until the final one."'}

{'translation': 'Brunson appeared in a sketch titled "Office MVP," playing a character named "Darius Barcelona" who crumples a sandwich wrapper into a paper ball to stop his coworkers from getting back to work after lunch, claiming they still have "seconds" left, before hurling the paper ball toward a trash can across the room.'}

{'translation': 'Brunson shot 38.9% from three-point range in the Finals — but this attempt fell well short.'}

{'translation': 'His subsequent tries were also badly off target, despite his coworkers urging him to stop throwing trash around.'}

{'translation': 'He eventually revealed his identity to his colleagues, saying he was Brunson, and they instantly turned into fans cheering him on. He leaned back in his office chair, ready to "sink the game-winner."'}

{'translation': "Brunson didn't disappoint, channeling his NBA champion form to nail the shot perfectly."}

{'translation': 'Bulla revealed that Brunson and the SNL cast had prepared two sets of cue cards for the ending — one for making the shot, and one for missing it.'}

{'translation': 'He added: "He missed it in dress rehearsal, but made it when it aired live, because @jalenbrunson1 is BUILT FOR THE MOMENT!!!"'}

{'translation': 'To catch the full "Office MVP" sketch from the Season 52 premiere of SNL, check it out now.'}
